rule.once: NIFTY 2024 is scored once with these books and rules unchanged; nothing is tuned on it, and the O30f sheet is scored first and independently
rule.stretch_rule_holds: per lot at the shipped size and brakes, the rule beats the same book without it on at least 2 of LIVE, BEST and TPB over 2024, AND the median of the 20 random books (one lot, no brakes) is higher with the rule than without it
rule.tpb_skip_candidate: TPB|skip at 3 lots, no brakes, Rs 200 extra per lot per trade: net > 0 over 2024 and largest fall <= 25% of the running peak
rule.best_skip_candidate: BEST|skip at 3 lots on the same terms
rule.live_skip_candidate: LIVE|skip at 3 lots on the same terms
rule.pick_candidate: the O30s frozen pick (TPB|HOUSE, 3 lots, half size when stretched) on the same terms
rule.no_change: nothing in the system changes on this result; the owner decides
